pages.title: Anti-Iron Ingot
pages.text: A bar of anti-iron, refined in levitation and cooled in vacuum. It rings like iron when the field taps it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Mirror Matter Foundry melts the ore without a crucible - the metal floats in a Penning field the whole time.
